current_repo_note: The licence file follows the structure of a well-known permissive licence but rewrites its grant using the wording of a different one, so no standard identifier applies and the hosting platform reports it only as other. The project's package metadata has its licence declaration commented out and publishes with none.
canonical_data: markdown memory notes and extracted reusable skills, held in two tracks
strengths: The core is small and inspectable, and the store itself makes no model calls at all
Memory lands on disk as plain markdown with front matter, editable by hand and readable if the tool is removed
One configured backend is shared across every host, so what one agent's sessions taught it, another retrieves
weaknesses: The licence file is a non-canonical rewrite that no identifier matches, and the package metadata declares no licence at all
No local embedding option is documented, so even the private deployment sends memory content to a third-party interface
Retrieval is cosine similarity alone, with no lexical fallback, reranking, recency, or temporal filtering
why_it_matters: Shows how far a memory service gets by storing plain markdown and delegating every judgement to the calling agent, at the cost of any built-in memory reasoning.
